name: Mind Flayer
senses: blindsight 120 ft., darkvision 120 ft., passive Perception 16

traits.name: Magic Resistance
traits.text: The mind flayer has advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

traits.name: Psionics
traits.text: The mind flayer has a swimming speed of 20 feet, can hover, and speaks Telepathy 120 ft. (described under Languages).

actions.name: Tentacles
actions.text: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 10 ft., one creature. Hit: 15 (2d10 + 4) psychic damage. The target must succeed on a DC 15 Intelligence saving throw or have its Intelligence score reduced by 1 (to a minimum of 1). Whenever the target's Intelligence is reduced to 0 by this damage, the target is stunned and immediately aware of its surroundings.

actions.name: Extract Brain
actions.text: The mind flayer kills one creature stunned by its tentacles by extracting and devouring its brain. The target must have an Intelligence of 5 or higher, and the mind flayer must be adjacent to it.
